sources.entry: OpenManus — Open-source framework for building general AI agents, created by the MetaGPT team as a fully open alternative to the invite-only Manus platform. Supports multi-agent flows, browser, shell, code execution, and web search. Also see OpenManus-RL for RL-based agent fine-tuning (GRPO). MIT.

summary.one_liner: OpenManus is an open-source Python framework from the MetaGPT team for building general-purpose AI agents, offered as a no-invite-code alternative to the Manus platform.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes OpenManus as a simple implementation of a general AI agent framework. Running main.py starts a terminal agent that takes a task typed by the user. A run_mcp.py entry point provides an MCP tool version, and a run_flow.py entry point provides a multi-agent flow that the README calls unstable. A DataAnalysis agent for data analysis and visualization can be enabled through a runflow setting in config.toml. By default, browser automation uses Browser Use CLI 3.0 as an MCP server started with uvx, and BrowserGym is also mentioned and requires Playwright. Configuration of LLM models, base URLs and API keys is done through config/config.toml, with a separate vision model section. The README also points to OpenManus-RL, a related project for reinforcement-learning tuning (such as GRPO) of LLM agents.
use_cases: Running a general-purpose AI agent from the terminal
Automating browser tasks with an LLM agent
Performing data analysis and visualization with an agent
Researching RL fine-tuning (GRPO) of LLM agents
how_to_run: conda create -n open_manus python=3.12 && conda activate open_manus
git clone the repository and cd OpenManus
pip install -r requirements.txt (or: uv venv --python 3.12, then uv pip install -r requirements.txt)
cp config/config.example.toml config/config.toml and add your LLM model, base_url and api_key
python main.py (single agent); python run_mcp.py (MCP version); python run_flow.py (multi-agent, unstable)
notable: Open alternative to the invite-only Manus platform, built by the MetaGPT team
Supports multiple run modes: single agent, MCP tool version, and multi-agent flow
Default browser automation via Browser Use CLI MCP server, with local Chrome or Browser Use Cloud options
Optional DataAnalysis agent for data analysis and visualization tasks
Related OpenManus-RL project for GRPO-style RL tuning of LLM agents
caveats: The README says the multi-agent run_flow version is unstable
Requires configuring your own LLM API keys in config.toml
BrowserGym needs a separate Playwright browser install; Browser Use Cloud needs a BROWSER_USE_API_KEY
The README calls it a simple implementation; the DataAnalysis agent needs extra dependencies from a separate installation guide
